# IFWD FlashTool E2

**Author:** Infineon Technologies Denmark A/S<br/>
**Platforms:** APOXI

<div className="screenshot">

![IFWD FlashTool E2: screenshot 1](./ifwd-flashtool-e2/img/ifwd-flashtool-e2.png)

</div>

IFWD FlashTool E2 downloads firmware, EEPROM, file system, NAND boot system, and DSP files to phones on the APOXI platform.

Serial and USB connections, multiple channels, checksum verification, flash memory pre-erase, and written data verification are supported. The package includes the `IFX_DL` console utility for flash automation.
